belongs_to_collection.name: The Orb Beyond the Rim Collection

data.overview: A drifter abducted from a distant world as a child becomes the target of an interstellar manhunt after discovering a mysterious sphere among the ruins of a dead colony. To learn why the relic matters, he must trust a ragtag crew of fugitives.
data.tagline: The universe has a price on his head.
data.title: The Orb Beyond the Rim
